posts.text: Congratulations to my former staffers, Lauren and Jordan! They met on my campaign, and now their son, Bear, has a little sister, Isla Louise Ann Hagert!

Budgets are values, and Congressional Republicans want to give another blank check to ICE. That is money that could fund 200,000 local law enforcement officers for three years or extend the health care premium tax credits for two years.

Video

Congratulations to Jessie Diggins on an incredible career. I look forward to your next chapter continuing to inspire others through your story and advocacy for mental health. And if anyone can complete an ultramarathon, it’s you.

startribune.com/jessie-diggi…

Ten years ago, when we lost Prince, thousands of Minnesotans filled the streets singing “Purple Rain.” A hometown star who had a way of bringing us together—and still does.

Video

I’ve heard loud and clear from brewers, farmers, & small businesses in Minnesota — a federal ban on hemp products would be devastating.

Today, Senator Paul & I are announcing a new bipartisan bill that protects Minnesota’s small businesses & farmers producing safe hemp products.
Americans will be paying the price for years to come.

Stunning footage from Artemis astronaut Reid Wiseman capturing Earth like we’ve never seen it before.


Reid Wiseman (@astro_reid)

Only one chance in this lifetime…

Like watching sunset at the beach from the most foreign seat in the cosmos, I couldn’t resist a cell phone video of Earthset. You can hear the shutter on the Nikon as @Astro_Christina is hammering away on 3-shot brackets and capturing those exceptional Earthset photos through the 400mm lens. @AstroVicGlover was in window 3 watching

Tragic news about the loss of Mark and Lisa’s daughter Maddy after a long illness.

Over the years I got to know Maddy and her sisters and I cannot imagine how difficult this is for them and Mark and Lisa. They were all there for her every step of the way. Maddy was such a smart and engaging person and always up for a talk.

Prayers with the Warner family today.

I got an update from Mayor Ressler and Blooming Prairie officials about the work to rebuild Hwy 218. Every time a truck passed, we could feel the road shake. I'm glad we got them federal funding, but they still need more support. This highway is a critical corridor for Southern Minnesota.

Good to be in Waseca. I’ve been working with community leaders to move this important public safety project forward.

Video

While Americans are worried about health care and rising costs, the president is focused on building a $400 million ballroom. That says everything about his priorities — and they’re not the American people.

Branelle Rodriguez grew up in Brainerd looking up at the night sky—now she’s helping lead Artemis II. Great to see a Minnesotan playing a key role in this historic mission.
startribune.com/brainerd-nat…

In Rochester, I joined the Salvation Army for “Stand with the Sam” to celebrate the Good Samaritan Health Clinic. The Salvation Army, Mayo partners, local dental providers, and the community continue to step up—bringing care and compassion to those who need it most.

In Faribault, I joined Sheriff Thomas and other leaders to tour the new Rice County Public Safety Center.

southernminn.com/faribault_d…

In Lino Lakes today with LIUNA union members who are doing the work, building our roads, repairing our bridges, and strengthening our economy. I'll always stand with the workers building Minnesota’s future.

Stopped by yesterday to thank the American Red Cross, volunteers, and everyone who came together to support and house those impacted by yesterday's tornadoes in Southern Minnesota.

Video

A jury has found what fans and artists have known for years: Ticketmaster/Live Nation is an anticompetitive monopoly.

That means higher fees and fewer choices.

We need real solutions that will increase competition and lower prices.

Video

This video shows just how close these tornadoes that touched down outside Rochester were to causing even more destruction. They took out many homes but thankfully no one was seriously injured. I’m grateful for the first responders and everyone who stepped up to keep people safe.


Ryan Hall, Y’all (@ryanhallyall)

Cars are just rolling past a fully planted tornado south of Rochester, Minnesota. Benny filmed this from the shoulder. - piped.video/watch?v=ZF-dKyEy…

Video
  





— https://nitter.n

The tornados that hit Stewartville & Marion township were dangerously strong today. Was in Rochester for Salvation Army dinner and also met with and thanked volunteers at the Red Cross emergency center shelter at Autumn Ridge church. So many homes damaged but thankfully no one died or seriously injured and all were taken in by friends, family and neighbors. Incredible work by Olmsted County first responders and the community. ❤️

In Waseca, I heard plans for a new, much-needed Justice Center that will break ground this fall. The county’s current courthouse is one of the oldest in the state, and I look forward to working with them on their new building.
